title: Kernel pair of a quotient by a monomorphic equivalence relation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U$ and $R$ be schemes over $S$, and let $j=(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be a monomorphism whose image on $T$-points is an equivalence relation on $U(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$. Let $U/R$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] of the presheaf quotient. Then the canonical map of fppf sheaves $h_R\to h_U\times_{U/R}h_U$ induced by $(s,t)$ is an isomorphism.
